name: Scalingo Databases

evidence.nosql: C01: managed MongoDB and OpenSearch are listed as Scalingo database engines
evidence.sql: C02: managed database hosting with relational SQL first; D01: native PostgreSQL and MySQL engines
evidence.kv: C08: Redis-compatible Caching protocol; C12: Caching plans priced per 30 days
evidence.vector: V01: pgvector 0.8.6 with HNSW and IVFFlat indexes

line: Managed PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, caching, and search databases.

free.text: 30d; 1 app/5 containers/1 small DB each; runs and bills or deletes after expiry

cells.metered: Postgres Starter €7.20/30 days; 512 MB RAM, 10 GB disk
cells.regions: Two Paris regions; SecNumCloud access is restricted

sql.math: €7.20 × 730 ÷ 720 = €7.30. The plan includes 10 GB of disk and 30 connections, but query performance is untested.
Idle, it stays provisioned for 730 hours: €7.20 × 730 ÷ 720 = €7.30. No lower idle rate for the database is published.

files.math: Scalingo database plans do not provide file storage.

jobs.math: Scalingo databases do not run worker jobs.
